passages.text: When Jehoshaphat king of Judah had returned safely to his home in Jerusalem, Jehu son of Hanani the seer went out to confront him and said to King Jehoshaphat, “Should you help the wicked and love those who hate the LORD? Because of this, the wrath of the LORD is upon you.
passages.sermon:
Jehoshaphat was the king of Judah.
He returned safely to his home in Jerusalem.
Jehu was the son of Hanani.
Jehu was a seer.
Jehu went out to meet Jehoshaphat.
Jehu spoke to King Jehoshaphat.
Jehu asked, “Should you help the wicked?”
Jehu also asked, “Should you love those who hate the LORD?”
Jehu said, “Because of this, the wrath of the LORD is upon you.”
passages.original: וַ֠יָּשָׁב יְהוֹשָׁפָ֨ט מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֧ה אֶל־ בֵּית֛וֹ בְּשָׁל֖וֹם לִֽירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ וַיֵּצֵ֣א אֶל־ פָּנָ֗יו יֵה֣וּא בֶן־ חֲנָ֘נִי֮ הַחֹזֶה֒ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֔ט הֲלָרָשָׁ֣ע לַעְזֹ֔ר וּלְשֹׂנְאֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תֶּאֱהָ֑ב וּבָזֹאת֙ עָלֶ֣יךָ קֶּ֔צֶף מִלִּפְנֵ֖י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: However, some good is found in you, for you have removed the Asherah poles from the land and have set your heart on seeking God.”
passages.sermon:
Jehoshaphat was king of Judah.
He did some good things.
He removed the Asherah poles from the land.
He set his heart on seeking God.
passages.original: אֲבָ֕ל דְּבָרִ֥ים טוֹבִ֖ים נִמְצְא֣וּ עִמָּ֑ךְ כִּֽי־ בִעַ֤רְתָּ הָאֲשֵׁרוֹת֙ מִן־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וַהֲכִינ֥וֹתָ לְבָבְךָ֖ לִדְרֹ֥שׁ הָֽאֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem, and once again he went out among the people from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim and turned them back to the LORD, the God of their fathers.
passages.sermon:
Jehoshaphat was king of Judah.
He lived in Jerusalem.
Jehoshaphat went out among the people.
He traveled from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim.
He turned the people back to the LORD.
The LORD is the God of their fathers.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑םס וַיָּ֜שָׁב וַיֵּצֵ֣א בָעָ֗ם מִבְּאֵ֥ר שֶׁ֙בַע֙ עַד־ הַ֣ר אֶפְרַ֔יִם וַיְשִׁיבֵ֕ם אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: He appointed judges in the land, in each of the fortified cities of Judah.
passages.sermon:
Jehoshaphat was king of Judah.
He lived in Jerusalem.
Jehoshaphat appointed judges.
He placed judges in the land of Judah.
He put judges in every fortified city.
Each city had its own judge.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲמֵ֨ד שֹֽׁפְטִ֜ים בָּאָ֗רֶץ בְּכָל־ עָרֵ֧י יְהוּדָ֛ה הַבְּצֻר֖וֹת לְעִ֥יר וָעִֽיר׃

passages.text: Then he said to the judges, “Consider carefully what you do, for you are not judging for man, but for the LORD, who is with you when you render judgment.
passages.sermon:
Jehoshaphat was the king of Judah.
He spoke to the judges he had appointed.
He said, "Pay close attention to your actions.
You do not judge for people.
You judge for the LORD.
The LORD is with you when you make decisions."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל־ הַשֹּֽׁפְטִ֗ים רְאוּ֙ מָֽה־ אַתֶּ֣ם עֹשִׂ֔ים כִּ֣י לֹ֧א לְאָדָ֛ם תִּשְׁפְּט֖וּ כִּ֣י לַיהוָ֑ה וְעִמָּכֶ֖ם בִּדְבַ֥ר מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

passages.text: And now, may the fear of the LORD be upon you. Be careful what you do, for with the LORD our God there is no injustice or partiality or bribery.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is our God.
He is always just.
He never shows partiality.
He never accepts bribes.
Let the fear of the LORD be upon you.
Be careful in all that you do.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה יְהִ֥י פַֽחַד־ יְהוָ֖ה עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם שִׁמְר֣וּ וַעֲשׂ֔וּ כִּֽי־ אֵ֞ין עִם־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ עַוְלָ֛ה וּמַשֹּׂ֥א פָנִ֖ים וּמִקַּח־ שֹֽׁחַד׃

passages.text: Moreover, Jehoshaphat appointed in Jerusalem some of the Levites, priests, and heads of the Israelite families to judge on behalf of the LORD and to settle disputes. And they lived in Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
Jehoshaphat was king of Judah.
He lived in Jerusalem.
Jehoshaphat appointed judges in Jerusalem.
He chose some Levites.
He chose some priests.
He chose some heads of the Israelite families.
They judged on behalf of the LORD.
They settled disputes among the people.
These judges lived in Jerusalem.
passages.original: וְגַ֣ם בִּ֠ירוּשָׁלִַם הֶעֱמִ֨יד יְהוֹשָׁפָ֜ט מִן־ הַלְוִיִּ֣ם וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים וּמֵרָאשֵׁ֤י הָאָבוֹת֙ לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְמִשְׁפַּ֥ט יְהוָ֖ה וְלָרִ֑יב וַיָּשֻׁ֖בוּ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: He commanded them, saying, “You must serve faithfully and wholeheartedly in the fear of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Jehoshaphat was king of Judah.
He appointed judges in Jerusalem.
He spoke to these judges.
He gave them a command.
He said, "You must serve in the fear of the LORD."
"You must act with faithfulness."
"You must have a whole and sincere heart."
passages.original: וַיְצַ֥ו עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר כֹּ֤ה תַעֲשׂוּן֙ בְּיִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה בֶּאֱמוּנָ֖ה וּבְלֵבָ֥ב שָׁלֵֽם׃

passages.text: For every dispute that comes before you from your brothers who dwell in their cities—whether it regards bloodshed or some other violation of law, commandments, statutes, or ordinances—you are to warn them, so that they will not incur guilt before the LORD and wrath will not come upon you and your brothers. Do this, and you will not incur guilt.
passages.sermon:
Jehoshaphat appointed judges in Jerusalem.
These judges were Levites, priests, and heads of Israelite families.
Their job was to judge for the LORD and settle disputes.
Sometimes, your brothers who live in their cities will bring disputes to you.
These disputes may be about bloodshed.
They may be about the law, commandments, statutes, or ordinances.
You must warn your brothers about what is right.
If you warn them, they will not become guilty before the LORD.
If you do not warn them, wrath may come on you and your brothers.
Do what I command you.
If you do this, you will not be guilty.
passages.original: וְכָל־ רִיב֩ אֲשֶׁר־ יָב֨וֹא עֲלֵיכֶ֜ם מֵאֲחֵיכֶ֣ם׀ הַיֹּשְׁבִ֣ים בְּעָרֵיהֶ֗ם בֵּֽין־ דָּ֣ם׀ לְדָם֮ בֵּין־ תּוֹרָ֣ה לְמִצְוָה֮ לְחֻקִּ֣ים וּלְמִשְׁפָּטִים֒ וְהִזְהַרְתֶּ֣ם אֹתָ֔ם וְלֹ֤א יֶאְשְׁמוּ֙ לַיהוָ֔ה וְהָֽיָה־ קֶ֥צֶף עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם וְעַל־ אֲחֵיכֶ֑ם כֹּ֥ה תַעֲשׂ֖וּן וְלֹ֥א תֶאְשָֽׁמוּ׃

passages.text: Note that Amariah, the chief priest, will be over you in all that pertains to the LORD, and Zebadiah son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, in all that pertains to the king. And the Levites will serve as officers before you. Act resolutely; may the LORD be with the upright!”
passages.sermon:
Amariah is the chief priest.
He will be over you in everything that concerns the LORD.
Zebadiah is the son of Ishmael.
Zebadiah is the ruler of the house of Judah.
He will be over you in everything that concerns the king.
The Levites will serve as officers before you.
Be strong.
Do your work.
May the LORD be with those who do what is good.
passages.original: וְהִנֵּ֡ה אֲמַרְיָ֣הוּ כֹהֵן֩ הָרֹ֨אשׁ עֲלֵיכֶ֜ם לְכֹ֣ל דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֗ה וּזְבַדְיָ֨הוּ בֶן־ יִשְׁמָעֵ֜אל הַנָּגִ֤יד לְבֵית־ יְהוּדָה֙ לְכֹ֣ל דְּבַר־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְשֹׁטְרִ֥ים הַלְוִיִּ֖ם לִפְנֵיכֶ֑ם חִזְק֣וּ וַעֲשׂ֔וּ וִיהִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִם־ הַטּֽוֹב׃פ
